info.title: Accounting API
info.description: Stage 1 manual accounting contract. Future imports, budgets, reports and sync transport are specified separately; no server exists yet.

post.description: Atomic user/workspace/session creation in explicitly enabled local/test registration. Disabled by default: 403 registration_disabled. Duplicate email uses generic validation_error, but immediate success/failure reveals availability; email verification is required before public registration.

get.summary: Restore current session and cookie CSRF token
get.description: Returns current session without creating a new one. Bearer response returns the presented token. Cache-Control: no-store.

post.summary: Extend idle expiry within absolute expiry
post.description: Does not rotate the credential. Idle expiry is min(now+7 days, absolute expiry); absolute lifetime 30 days.

delete.description: Already revoked own session returns ok. Unknown or foreign session returns 404.

post.description: Only unsplit expense/income without active refunds; category/tags replace existing values. Transfers/refunds/adjustments/opening/split operations rejected. Whole package rolls back on any failure. Linked transfer fees are rejected; edit them through PUT with expected_parent_version.

get.description: Returns whole committed groups only; max 4 MiB per page. Apply groups and advance cursor in one local DB transaction. Expired cursor => 410 cursor_expired. Empty page retains cursor.

post.description: Read-only materialization, Idempotency-Key must equal body id. Retries reuse same actor/workspace/id snapshot while live. No journal group, not a financial actions receipt. Expired id => 410 snapshot_expired; use new snapshot id.

get.description: Actor-scoped immutable snapshot metadata; TTL 15 minutes. Reauthorize membership on every read.
Fixed pages of at most 100 items. Repeat same token returns same page while snapshot lives. Install staged mirror and resume cursor only after final page.

Only receipts of current actor. 404 means no completed receipt, not proof that a concurrent request cannot commit. Full result retained 30 days; compact receipt retained for workspace lifetime. Null response_body after expiry. generation_id identifies the original applied stream; rejected has null. Across a generation reset reconcile through a fresh snapshot, not by comparing sequence numbers.

Version.description: Positive int64 encoded as a string; server checks <= 9223372036854775807.

Money.description: Signed minor units, absolute value <= 9000000000000000; encoded as a canonical decimal integer string.

Instant.description: UTC RFC3339 instant ending in Z.

Timezone.description: IANA timezone; checked against timezone database.

email.description: MVP accepts ASCII email only. Identity uses trimmed ASCII lowercase of entire address; not password normalization.

password.description: Exact UTF-8 secret; no trimming or Unicode normalization. Registration minimum 12 code points, maximum 128; malformed UTF-8/surrogates rejected.

email.description: MVP accepts ASCII email only. Identity uses trimmed ASCII lowercase of entire address; not password normalization.

password.description: Exact UTF-8 secret; no trimming or Unicode normalization. Registration minimum 12 code points, maximum 128; malformed UTF-8/surrogates rejected.

remaining_refundable_minor.description: Nonnegative remaining amount only for allocations of expense; zero for all other kinds. Active posted/pending refunds reserve the limit.

ExpenseReplace.description: Kind, identity and monetary currency/currency pair are immutable. Account changes only within the same currency. Cross-field invariants are checked by service.

IncomeReplace.description: Kind, identity and monetary currency/currency pair are immutable. Account changes only within the same currency. Cross-field invariants are checked by service.

fee.description: For an existing fee its UUID and currency are immutable. Explicit null removes fee after dependency checks.

TransferReplace.description: Kind, identity and monetary currency/currency pair are immutable. Account changes only within the same currency. Cross-field invariants are checked by service.

parent_transaction_id.description: Must equal immutable parent of existing refund; changing parent is rejected.

RefundReplace.description: Kind, identity and monetary currency/currency pair are immutable. Account changes only within the same currency. Cross-field invariants are checked by service.

Sequence.description: Committed workspace group sequence, zero for empty workspace; service checks int64 range.

SyncCursor.description: Opaque integrity-protected workspace/actor/protocol-bound journal cursor. Not a list pagination cursor.

PageToken.description: Opaque snapshot-specific token. Immutable page position; not a sync cursor.

WorkspaceChange.description: One item of an atomic committed group; envelope/payload workspace_id must match.

AggregateMoney.description: Exact aggregate minor units, up to 40 digits; uses arbitrary precision, not int64/float. Input and individual account money keep the narrower Money limit.

ActionId.name: Idempotency-Key
ActionId.description: Actor/workspace scoped action UUID; retry unchanged request with same key.

SyncGeneration.name: X-Sync-Generation
SyncGeneration.description: Generation observed from workspace or snapshot. Existing receipt replay checks original hash first; a new action in a stale generation is rejected without financial write.

Error403.description: CSRF check failed or operation forbidden

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present when returning a registered terminal action result; true on retained replay, false on initial completion. Not set for nonregistered errors.
